sentiment.key_risk: A surprise in US inflation/Fed guidance or a sudden geopolitical shock that pushes oil sharply higher is the biggest risk to the bullish opening.
sentiment.summary: Most headlines point to a gap-up/higher open for the Nifty driven by softer crude, a firmer rupee and positive GIFT Nifty futures/foreign buying. Offsetting risks are firming Fed hike odds and episodic geopolitical oil-supply concerns that could quickly reverse gains.
